[Rod M] Heated seats are easier to implement imo, think a small electric blanket imbedded in the seat. Cooling requires ducting and fans etc
[bio] Peltier cooling is a thing, but I'm not sure whether it's used in car seats.
[FuRyZ] Running an AC duct under the floor and piping it into the bottom of the seat is far simpler than trying to implement a peltier cooled seat.
Peltiers are glorified heat pumps, and their ability to cool is only as good as your ability to keep the hot side of the peltier under control. You typically use large heatsinks and noisy fans to keep that hot side of the peltier, temperature stable. I dont think anyone wants a fan blowing hot air out from under the seat just so you can cool the surface of the car seat.
But you could solve this peltier heat problem by ducting cooled AC air to the peltier… then why not just send that cooled air straight to seat… like every other cooled seat does. See how this solution makes no sense.
